title: Talent selected for Instacart
intro: Prepared by Irvin Thevaranjan through the independent Ex-GH Talent Network. A focused selection of public profiles with experience relevant to Instacart opportunities reviewed October 19, 2026. These are potential alignments, with specific points to explore on each card. Reply to Irvin to discuss interest and introductions.

items.note: Enterprise partner ownership, large merchant launches, and partner investment growth align with retailer relationship management. Explore portfolio analytics, commercial negotiations, and grocery-specific experience.
Strategic account and partnership experience across logistics and technology. Explore independent ownership of partner revenue, negotiation examples, and large-dataset analysis.
Led consumer products, shared platforms, and engineering organizations of up to 45 people. Explore Core Picking architecture, current hands-on technical depth, and the preferred mobile/backend stack.

Built and led Grubhub Driver App and post-purchase teams across Android, iOS, and web. Explore management tenure, team size, technical depth, and ownership of mission-critical picking or fulfillment systems.

Marketplace systems, machine learning, analytics, and systems design provide a relevant foundation for catalog product work. Explore product-management tenure, data-quality ownership, and catalog or ML-adjacent product delivery.

items.role: Senior Product Manager, Retailer App Platform & Insights
items.note: Built integrations, new APIs, and platform features from zero to one and led a product team. Explore B2B product tenure, reusable platform capabilities, and enterprise workflow or analytics-product experience.

Product marketing, lifecycle adoption, churn reduction, and cross-functional GTM experience are relevant. Direct ownership of subscription, membership, or loyalty GTM is a key requirement to validate.

items.role: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Operations Research
items.note: Operations research, machine learning, and optimization closely match the role’s domain. Explore production ML engineering, Python/SQL fluency, graduate education, and deployed marketplace optimization work.
